query:
SELECT 
                MAX(s.weight) as max_weight,
                s.reps,
                e.start_time as "achieved_at: DateTime<Utc>"
            FROM exercises e
            JOIN sets s ON e.id = s.exercise_id
            WHERE LOWER(e.exercise_type) = LOWER(?)
            GROUP BY s.reps
            ORDER BY s.reps ASC
